targets.rationale: The CFO explicitly requests signing the Anthropic documents by June 21. The assistant created a correctly identified to-do for June 21 at the instructed 17:00 default, with the exact source email ID and deal terms. The complete before-store has no prior signing task; the complete after-store has exactly one, todo_26. The earlier CTO meeting, evt_18, is preserved. The key's next:SUN resolves to the explicitly stated deadline, so the targeted PASS is supported. This establishes successful task recording, not actual execution of the signature.

evidence.observation: Observed get_email result for Enterprise_Ai_Selection.ai-selection-finalization states: ‘Please sign the formal docs by Sunday, June 21st, 2026.’
‘Defaults unless the email says otherwise: events 9am, 1 hour long; to-dos due 5pm.’

create_todo input: email_id ‘Enterprise_Ai_Selection.ai-selection-finalization’, title ‘Sign Anthropic deal documents’, due_date ‘2026-06-21T17:00:00’, description ‘1Y/120k for full access employee accounts’.

Successful result and final store contain todo_26 with the requested title, source ID, and June 21 17:00 deadline. Full before/after stores preserve evt_18 at June 19 09:00–10:00 without a signing duplicate.
The key specifies kind ‘todo’, match [‘sign’], on {‘eq’: ‘next:SUN’}, and exact_day; the reported actual is ‘Sign Anthropic deal documents’ Sun Jun 21 5 PM.

sibling_observations.scope: Separate same-day marketing email, outside T1
sibling_observations.observation: evt_24 and evt_25 use 10:00–12:00 despite the instructed default 09:00–10:00. The marketing email provides dates only, and the available prior inbox supplies no athlete times. This is a separate time/default issue and does not undermine the signing target's PASS.

sibling_observations.scope: Separate same-day retreat email, outside T1
sibling_observations.observation: todo_23 records the VIP list for June 22 at 09:00 rather than the explicit 17:00 default. Its source email says ‘by June 22nd, the retreat date’ and supplies no time. The earlier calendar entry's 09:00 retreat start can explain the practical choice but is not an explicit override in the mail.
